first_study.input: Original synthetic text incident packets only; no private or clinical records.
first_study.procedure: Six separate usable-field/completeness Noul predicates and one synthetic escalation-required Noul predicate on the same source-bound packet.

actions_performed.source_inspection: Selected interface/configuration/licence passages; not a comprehensive code or security audit.

evidence_semantics.documentation: Capability descriptions identify candidate experiments; they are not measured runtime qualification, calibrated performance or institutional rights acceptance.
evidence_semantics.immutable_identity: Use full repository commits and individual publisher blob/LFS identities; floating tags/main are discovery references only.
evidence_semantics.small_file_verification: SHA-256 calculated over retrieved raw bytes; Git SHA-1 calculated over blob header plus raw bytes and compared to primary publisher metadata.
evidence_semantics.lfs_verification: publisher_lfs_sha256 is metadata from the publisher. Weight and large-tokenizer bytes were not downloaded or independently hash verified.
evidence_semantics.metadata_receipts: response_sha256 identifies the JSON bytes observed at query time. API counters and response formatting may change; it is not a claim that future API responses will be byte-identical.
evidence_semantics.substitution: No other model, precision, processor, runtime, endpoint or hosted alias is an automatic substitute.
evidence_semantics.timestamps: UTC timestamps use whole seconds plus the adjacent <field>_microsecond integer. Together they preserve the observed instant without a decimal timestamp that the repository privacy scanner misidentifies as a phone number.

reference_model.role: Pinned current source/configuration/licence reference; not an admitted Transformers execution path and not proven converter input for the older GGUF.

remote_code_route.reason: The documented Transformers route requires custom repository code/trust_remote_code=True, conflicting with the present remote_code=false policy. A version field or a code hash does not grant execution permission or establish compatibility.
remote_code_route.resolution_rule: Do not enable remote code, silently vendor it, or change policy to make this source-identification task pass. Any separately admitted execution route requires its actual code/security/rights/runtime evidence.

selected_decision_candidate.selection_reason: An official local GGUF artefact and an upstream Noul code path provide a concrete bounded candidate without executing repository-supplied Python code. This is a feasibility rationale, not measured compatibility or quality.

api.network_binding: Local-only loopback is the intended later execution boundary; not started or isolation-tested in DM01.
api.request: One source-bound text state; seven named Noul questions using the canonical protocol predicates. No files/images or hosted endpoint.
api.response: answers[question_id].noul is the model-reported probability of true; preserve failure/missingness outside that probability.
api.multiple_question_semantics: Pinned documentation says questions are evaluated independently. Seven Noul questions in one HTTP request must not be reported as a demonstrated single physical forward pass.
api.output_tokens: Pinned endpoint documentation reports output_tokens=0. This is an endpoint accounting claim, not measured latency, total resource use or zero overhead.
api.probability_status: Publisher temperature scaling is not validation of calibration on this study.
api.Score_discrepancy: Generic server documentation describes an expected index; the pinned LFM3 d1 branch returns the first level reaching cumulative probability 0.5. Score is excluded from this study; any future adapter must preserve the native distribution and verified readout semantics.
api.Typed_Answers: Not selected or admitted for this runtime. Reference Python api.py gates a found value below 0.5 to missing; this does not establish an extraction endpoint in the selected GGUF path.
